report.summary: Patient P-D012 (age 47, Medicaid/Lakeshore Community Health Plan, home tract 17031230500) needs help with medication costs and transportation. Screener (2026-09-30) indicates transportation difficulty and housing instability. Medicaid transport benefit is active. Eligible transport option: Medicaid Ride Line for plan members, call at least 2 business days ahead. Senior Shuttle is not eligible (age 60+). Paratransit is an option only if the patient pursues ADA certification (up to 21 days). Medication cost options: Clinic Rx Fund short-term copay help for current patients; Community Pharmacy Assistance for Extra Help/manufacturer program applications; prescription savings card signup form (eligibility determined after submission).
